account_invitations_email_check.name: account_invitations_email_check
account_invitations_email_check.value: "account_invitations"."email" = lower("account_invitations"."email") and length("account_invitations"."email") between 3 and 320 and position('@' in "account_invitations"."email") > 1

account_invitations_accepted_fields_chec.name: account_invitations_accepted_fields_check
account_invitations_accepted_fields_chec.value: ("account_invitations"."status" = 'accepted' and "account_invitations"."accepted_user_id" is not null and "account_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null) or ("account_invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' and "account_invitations"."accepted_user_id" is null and "account_invitations"."accepted_at" is null)

account_invitations_failure_fields_check.name: account_invitations_failure_fields_check
account_invitations_failure_fields_check.value: ("account_invitations"."status" = 'failed' and "account_invitations"."failure_code" is not null and "account_invitations"."failed_at" is not null) or ("account_invitations"."status" <> 'failed' and "account_invitations"."failure_code" is null and "account_invitations"."failed_at" is null)

account_invitations_revoked_at_check.name: account_invitations_revoked_at_check
account_invitations_revoked_at_check.value: ("account_invitations"."status" = 'revoked' and "account_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null) or ("account_invitations"."status" <> 'revoked' and "account_invitations"."revoked_at" is null)

article_sources_acquisition_provenance_c.name: article_sources_acquisition_provenance_check
article_sources_acquisition_provenance_c.value: ("article_sources"."acquisition_candidate_id" is null and "article_sources"."acquisition_candidate_revision" is null and "article_sources"."fetched_at" is null) or ("article_sources"."acquisition_candidate_id" is not null and "article_sources"."acquisition_candidate_revision" > 0 and "article_sources"."fetched_at" is not null)

acquisition_runs_completed_at_check.name: acquisition_runs_completed_at_check
acquisition_runs_completed_at_check.value: ("acquisition_runs"."status" = 'running' and "acquisition_runs"."completed_at" is null) or ("acquisition_runs"."status" <> 'running' and "acquisition_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

content_candidates_publication_fields_ch.name: content_candidates_publication_fields_check
content_candidates_publication_fields_ch.value: ("content_candidates"."publication_status" = 'draft' and "content_candidates"."publication_ref" is null and "content_candidates"."published_candidate_revision" is null and "content_candidates"."published_content_hash" is null and "content_candidates"."published_at_internal" is null and "content_candidates"."archived_at" is null) or ("content_candidates"."publication_status" = 'published' and "content_candidates"."publication_ref" is not null and "content_candidates"."published_candidate_revision" is not null and "content_candidates"."published_content_hash" is not null and "content_candidates"."published_at_internal" is not null and "content_candidates"."archived_at" is null) or ("content_candidates"."publication_status" = 'archived' and "content_candidates"."publication_ref" is not null and "content_candidates"."published_candidate_revision" is not null and "content_candidates"."published_content_hash" is not null and "content_candidates"."published_at_internal" is not null and "content_candidates"."archived_at" is not null)

content_candidates_rejected_at_check.name: content_candidates_rejected_at_check
content_candidates_rejected_at_check.value: ("content_candidates"."status" = 'rejected' and "content_candidates"."rejected_at" is not null) or ("content_candidates"."status" <> 'rejected' and "content_candidates"."rejected_at" is null)

content_pipeline_runs_completed_at_check.name: content_pipeline_runs_completed_at_check
content_pipeline_runs_completed_at_check.value: ("content_pipeline_runs"."status" = 'running' and "content_pipeline_runs"."completed_at" is null) or ("content_pipeline_runs"."status" <> 'running' and "content_pipeline_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

content_pipeline_steps_completed_at_chec.name: content_pipeline_steps_completed_at_check
content_pipeline_steps_completed_at_chec.value: ("content_pipeline_steps"."status" = 'running' and "content_pipeline_steps"."completed_at" is null) or ("content_pipeline_steps"."status" <> 'running' and "content_pipeline_steps"."completed_at" is not null)

media_assets_expiry_policy_check.name: media_assets_expiry_policy_check
media_assets_expiry_policy_check.value: "media_assets"."kind" = 'official_embed' or "media_assets"."provider_key" = 'language-reactor' or "media_assets"."provider_key" like 'supabase-storage:%' or ("media_assets"."kind" in ('audio', 'video') and "media_assets"."provider_key" = 'bunny-storage') or "media_assets"."playback_expires_at" is not null

media_versions_acquisition_provenance_ch.name: media_versions_acquisition_provenance_check
media_versions_acquisition_provenance_ch.value: ("media_versions"."acquisition_candidate_id" is null and "media_versions"."acquisition_candidate_revision" is null and "media_versions"."fetched_at" is null) or ("media_versions"."acquisition_candidate_id" is not null and "media_versions"."acquisition_candidate_revision" > 0 and "media_versions"."fetched_at" is not null)

media_versions_artwork_fields_check.name: media_versions_artwork_fields_check
media_versions_artwork_fields_check.value: ("media_versions"."artwork_url" is null and "media_versions"."artwork_alt" is null and "media_versions"."artwork_source" is null and "media_versions"."artwork_width" is null and "media_versions"."artwork_height" is null and "media_versions"."artwork_expires_at" is null) or ("media_versions"."artwork_url" is not null and "media_versions"."artwork_alt" is not null and "media_versions"."artwork_source" is not null and (("media_versions"."artwork_width" is null and "media_versions"."artwork_height" is null) or ("media_versions"."artwork_width" > 0 and "media_versions"."artwork_height" > 0)))

media_series_memberships_numbers_check.name: media_series_memberships_numbers_check
media_series_memberships_numbers_check.value: ("media_series_memberships"."season_number" is null or "media_series_memberships"."season_number" >= 0) and ("media_series_memberships"."episode_number" is null or "media_series_memberships"."episode_number" >= 0)

corpus_occurrences_one_entry_check.name: corpus_occurrences_one_entry_check
corpus_occurrences_one_entry_check.value: (("corpus_occurrences"."lexeme_id" is not null)::int + ("corpus_occurrences"."phrase_entry_id" is not null)::int) = 1

lexicon_candidate_approvals_batch_id_che.name: lexicon_candidate_approvals_batch_id_check
lexicon_candidate_approvals_batch_id_che.value: ("lexicon_candidate_approvals"."mode" = 'batch' and "lexicon_candidate_approvals"."batch_id" is not null) or ("lexicon_candidate_approvals"."mode" = 'single' and "lexicon_candidate_approvals"."batch_id" is null)

lexicon_candidates_approved_audit_check.name: lexicon_candidates_approved_audit_check
lexicon_candidates_approved_audit_check.value: "lexicon_candidates"."status" <> 'approved' or ("lexicon_candidates"."approved_by" is not null and "lexicon_candidates"."approved_at" is not null)

lexicon_form_frequencies_example_identit.name: lexicon_form_frequencies_example_identity_check
lexicon_form_frequencies_example_identit.value:
("lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_document_kind" = 'article' and "lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_document_stable_key" is null and "lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_document_version" is null and "lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_segment_index" is null)
      or ("lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_document_kind" = 'media' and "lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_document_stable_key" is not null and "lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_document_version" is not null and "lexicon_form_frequencies"."example_segment_index" is not null)

scenario_turns_completed_at_check.name: scenario_turns_completed_at_check
scenario_turns_completed_at_check.value: ("scenario_turns"."status" = 'completed' and "scenario_turns"."completed_at" is not null) or ("scenario_turns"."status" <> 'completed' and "scenario_turns"."completed_at" is null)
